transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... well, I guess I'm just having some trouble shaking certain thoughts lately. I manage computer systems for a living, and... I just keep getting stuck on this idea that if I miss one setting, or... one access rule, or a warning sign... that someone could get hurt. Or lose everything. 

Part of me knows it's irrational, but... it hits me like I'm personally responsible. And I just... I can't seem to move on from it.
Do you find yourself repeatedly checking or double-checking your work to try and relieve these thoughts?

Yeah... I do. I, um... I end up rereading things. A lot. Deployment plans, the audit logs... even just old messages. Over and over. Sometimes I have to... count through the steps in my head until it feels safe. 

It's not just the systems, either. It's... door locks, things like that. I don't really like to admit it, but I've been staying at the office for hours after everyone else goes home. If I try to stop before it feels complete, I... I start to panic. So I just stay.
Do you experience these overwhelming thoughts or the need to check things when you're not working or thinking about your job?
Um... I guess so. Sometimes. Like I said, the... the door locks. But, um... mostly it's just work stuff. I don't really know what else to say about it.
Are these thoughts and checking behaviors affecting your relationships with family or friends?

Um... I guess so. Yeah. I mean, I don't really see people as much anymore. I used to go to, um, this basketball thing, and a salsa night... but I just stopped showing up. I don't really have the time, I guess. 

And, um... work is... it's getting hard. I missed a really big deadline recently. A cloud migration. I just... I couldn't sign off on the decisions. It wasn't... it didn't feel right yet. Now my team is kind of... they just work around me. They don't really come to me for things anymore.
Do you feel like these thoughts are coming from your own mind and are a part of who you are?

Um... I'm not really sure how to answer that. I mean... they're in my head, so I guess they're mine. But I don't really... I don't know if I'd say it's who I am. It's just... what happens. I haven't really thought about it like that.
Do you feel like these thoughts are something you want to have, or are they unwelcome and something you wish you could stop?

No, I... I definitely don't want them. I wish they would just stop. 

It's... it's why I'm here, I guess. I just keep getting these thoughts that... if I miss just one setting on a server, or one access rule... or some warning sign... that someone could get hurt. Or lose everything. 

And... I mean, part of me knows it doesn't make sense. But it just... it hits me so hard. Like I'm personally responsible if something goes wrong. And I just... I can't move past it. I can't just let it go.
Do you feel anxious when you're around other people, outside of work?
No, not really. I mean... I don't really see people much anyway, like I said. But it's not... I'm not anxious about the people themselves. It's just... I'd rather be home.
Are you feeling overwhelmed or unable to cope with your daily life due to these thoughts and checking behaviors?

Yeah... I guess you could say that. It's... it's affecting things. 

At work, I... I missed a major deadline recently. A big cloud migration. I just... I couldn't sign off on the decisions. I kept needing to check things. And now... my team, they kind of just work around me. They don't really rely on me right now. 

And outside of work... I don't know. I used to play basketball, go to these salsa nights... but I just stopped showing up. I don't really have the energy for it. So... yeah. I'm just kind of losing the things that used to keep me grounded, I guess.
Are there any other areas of your life, besides work and social activities, that are being affected by these thoughts and checking behaviors?
No... I don't think so. Just... what I already said. Work, and... not going out. That's pretty much it.
Do you feel like these thoughts and checking behaviors are significantly interfering with your overall well-being or happiness?
Yeah... I suppose so. I mean, I'm not really... happy, right now. It's just exhausting. So, yes.
Are there any recurring thoughts that disturb or worry you, unrelated to your job or responsibilities at work?

Not really... unrelated, no. It all kind of ties back to what I do. I just... I keep having these thoughts that if I miss one setting, or... an access rule, or some warning sign... someone could get hurt. Or they'll lose everything. 

Part of me knows it’s irrational, but... it just feels like I'd be personally responsible. I can't just move on from it. So... yeah. That's mostly what it is.
Do you feel like these thoughts and checking behaviors are causing you a lot of distress?
Yeah... I guess so. I mean, like I said, it's just exhausting. So... yes. It's a lot. I don't really know what else to say about it.
Are your thoughts about potential harm or mistakes mostly limited to your work with computer systems?
Yeah... pretty much. I don't really notice it with anything else. Just... the systems at work.
Do these thoughts about missing a setting or access rule feel like they are forcing themselves into your mind?

Yeah... I suppose so. It's like I was saying, I just... keep getting them. They just kind of happen. That thought that if I miss one setting... or a warning sign... someone could get hurt, or lose everything. It just... hits me. Even when part of me knows it’s irrational, it just forces its way in. And... I feel like I'm personally responsible. I just can't move on from it.
Do you feel like these thoughts are in line with your own values and beliefs?
I don't... I mean, I guess I'm not really sure what you mean by that. They're just thoughts. I don't know if they have anything to do with my values.
Do you feel like these thoughts are consistent with the kind of person you think you are?

I don't really look at it like that. I mean... I'm a careful guy, I guess. I take my work seriously. But... no. I don't think having these thoughts all the time is who I am. I just... I don't know. I'm just trying to get through the day.
Do you feel like these thoughts are something that are a part of you, or are they alien to your own way of thinking?
I don't know if I'd say "alien." That sounds... extreme. They're in my head, so I guess they're part of me. But I don't want them there. I just... I don't know how else to explain it.
Are there any thoughts that disturb or worry you that don't have to do with your job or feeling responsible for something?
No, I don't... I don't think so. It's really just the work stuff. And making sure things are... handled. I haven't really noticed anything else.
Do you feel like these thoughts are in conflict with your own self-image or the way you see yourself?

I don't know about self-image. It's just... I'm supposed to be the one keeping the systems secure. But I just keep getting these thoughts that... if I miss one setting, or one access rule, or some warning sign... someone could get hurt. Or lose everything. Part of me knows it doesn't make sense, but... it just hits me like I'm personally responsible for it all. And I can't just let it go. It's just... it's a lot.
Do you feel like these thoughts are something that you would normally think, or are they foreign to your usual way of thinking?

I mean... I think I just said, I wouldn't call them foreign. They're in my head. I just... I don't really know how to categorize them for you. They're just there. I'm not really sure how else to answer that.
